items.title: Microsoft fixes Exchange sign-ins broken by Windows Server updates
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.summary: Microsoft has fixed Outlook sign-in and mail delivery issues on Exchange Server systems after installing the October 2026 Windows Server security updates.

items.title: Railway breach leads to $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.summary: Cloud hosting provider Railway says hackers exploited vulnerabilities in its infrastructure to steal customer authentication secrets and generate approximately $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage, potentially exposing credentials for up to 100,000 workspaces.

items.title: Japanese furniture giant Nitori says hackers stole 37.6M customer records
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.summary: Nitori, a major Japanese furniture and home accessories retailer, discovered that an attacker accessed a system on its network and may have stolen 37.62 million customer records.

items.title: Microsoft releases Windows 10 KB5131096 extended security update
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.summary: Microsoft released the Windows 10 KB5131096 extended security update, which includes this month's November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes and a few bug fixes and changes.

items.title: Hackers exploit trusted AWS access to breach multiple cloud environments
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.summary: A threat actor used compromised identity and access management (IAM) credentials for a Qubole big data platform's AWS account to access and exfiltrate data from multiple customers' AWS environments.

items.title: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 flaws, Outlook zero-day
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.summary: Today is Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday, with security updates addressing a record-breaking 1,235 flaws, including one actively exploited Microsoft Outlook zero-day vulnerability.

items.title: Windows 11 KB5132061 & KB5131087 cumulative updates released
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.summary: Microsoft has released the Patch Tuesday Windows 11 and cumulative updates for versions 26H2/25H2/24H2 and 23H2 to fix security vulnerabilities and bugs, and add new features.

items.title: Critical Xen Orchestra auth bypass flaw exploited to hijack VM servers
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Xen Orchestra is being actively exploited in attacks that could grant administrator privileges and allow takeover of XCP-ng virtualization hosts.

items.title: Binance warns of iOS flaw that could leak crypto wallet secrets
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.summary: Binance is warning about a vulnerability in Apple's iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1, and 27.2 that could allow third-party apps to read private files stored by other apps, including cryptocurrency seed phrases, secret keys, and login credentials.

items.title: Ransomware recovery is now a client retention metric
items.author: Sponsored by Kaseya
items.summary: Recovering from ransomware doesn't guarantee an MSP will retain its clients, especially when delays, poor communication, and unexpected costs undermine trust. Kaseya examines how disconnected recovery tools create these problems and how integrated workflows can improve response times, transparency,

items.title: SAP patches ICM2SHELL and PROXYGATE maximum severity flaws
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.summary: SAP patched 35 vulnerabilities in its November 2026 security updates, including four maximum-severity issues affecting its NetWeaver, Web Dispatcher, and Gateway software.

items.title: Hackers now exploit critical Barracuda ESG flaws to gain root access
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.summary: Cybersecurity company Barracuda Networks warned that attackers have begun exploiting two recently patched Email Security Gateway (ESG) vulnerabilities that let them run commands with root privileges.

items.title: Turla hackers use new Cereal malware to spy on govt Exchange servers
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.summary: The Russian state-backed threat group Turla has been using a new malicious toolset called 'Cereal' to intercept emails on Microsoft Exchange servers at government organizations.

items.title: Google patches eighth Chrome zero-day exploited in attacks this year
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.summary: Google has released emergency security updates to patch a new Chrome vulnerability exploited in zero-day attacks, the eighth such flaw since the start of the year.

items.title: Fireworks AI discloses new breach after cloud provider hack
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.summary: AI infrastructure startup Fireworks has disclosed a new security breach in which attackers accessed its development machines after breaching a third-party cloud provider.
